findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "accept_work" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.ableandagent.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_interest, quote_act, list_acts, list_messages, accept_work, cancel_act · Public sink: register_interest, quote_act, commission_act, send_message, accept_work, decline_work, withdraw_act, cancel_act · Destructive: commission_act, cancel_act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_interest, quote_act, list_acts, list_messages, accept_work, cancel_act · Public sink: register_interest, quote_act, commission_act, send_message, accept_work, decline_work, withdraw_act, cancel_act · Destructive: commission_act, cancel_act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
